raw_text: DFRLab Investigation: Fabricated Kashmir Atrocity Videos Traced to Pakistani Accounts. The Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab has confirmed that videos purportedly showing Indian security force violence in Kashmir are fabricated. Digital forensics revealed the footage originated from conflict zones in Syria and Myanmar, with audio dubbed in Kashmiri dialect and metadata systematically stripped. The operation was coordinated through accounts traced to Pakistani IP ranges, timed to the Article 370 anniversary.
clean_text: DFRLab confirmed Kashmir atrocity videos are fabricated using Syrian and Myanmar footage. Audio dubbed in Kashmiri with metadata stripped. Operation coordinated from Pakistani IP ranges timed to Article 370 anniversary.
